messages.content: What's the average temperature for Los Angeles in December?

message.content:
In December, Los Angeles typically enjoys mild winter weather:

| Time | Average Temperature |
|------|---------------------|
| Daytime highs | ~16–19 °C (61–66 °F) |
| Night‑time lows | ~9–12 °C (48–54 °F) |

So you can expect comfortable daytime temperatures just above 60 °F, dropping into the mid‑40s at night. Rainfall is relatively light—about 2–5 mm per month on average—and sunshine remains plentiful.
